title: Río Hondo College Student Marco Ayala Inspires Local Community Through Baking and Storytelling - NewsBreak
text:
37 minutes ago Marco Ayala is a first-year student at Río Hondo College. He is majoring in Film, Television, and Electronic Media. Ayala is also active on TikTok, where he shares content about his experiences and interests. He describes himself as open to many topics and works on different projects across social media platforms.
Ayala started a dessert business called MarcoCookiez. He sees baking as a way to connect with others. His business offers three main products: Mini Moments, Main Characters, and MarcoBrowniez. The business aims to provide comfort and creativity through its products. Ayala uses the phrase, 'Let’s bake the world a better place,' to describe his approach.
On TikTok, Ayala shares motivational and personal stories. He encourages viewers to be themselves and follow their interests. He focuses on authenticity and hopes to support others in their personal and professional goals. His content has attracted attention from other students and viewers.
Ayala has family members who attended Río Hondo College. He participates in programs such as Guardian Scholars, NextUp, and Extended Opportunity Programs and Services. These programs have supported his academic and personal development. He has also taken part in campus activities, including a marketing photoshoot.
After earning his GED, Ayala chose Río Hondo College to study storytelling and public speaking. He has faced challenges but sees them as learning opportunities. He is working toward an associate degree and is considering transferring to another institution. Ayala advises other students to be authentic and open to new experiences, reflecting the values of Río Hondo College.
